scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.description: B2B support across chat and ticket channels
app.access_detail: Only admins can create API tokens; an existing workspace is required.
app.surface: REST; issues, accounts, contacts and knowledge base
app.note: Use a scoped operational workflow; quotas differ by endpoint.
app.workflow: Read an issue and its account
app.next_action: Ask a Pylon administrator for scoped test credentials and retrieve one seeded issue with its account relationship.
app.success_criterion: Return the issue/account identifiers and record the quota for the chosen operation.
app.alternative_action: Inspect the authorized issue-detail UI only to identify fields absent from the public issue schema.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
